decisions.reason: A newly launched handle family whose market value is still uncertain is cheap to keep in a modular range, so the option stays open.
The mitred lever family has only one year of evidence, and it shares production and finishing with the core range, so keeping it costs little while uncertainty remains.
This single multifunctional handle has no negative signal yet and supports the firm's accessibility direction, so it is worth keeping to learn more.
A door lever line launched only in 2023 has not revealed its value yet, and the low holding cost justifies waiting.
The German Design Award and its own dedicated page are early positive results that justify further commitment rather than abandonment.
A finish option uses existing finishing capability at minimal cost and adds variety across product families, so it is kept while demand becomes clear.
